programs.description: Daniel's grandfather, who is a strict patriarch, has the final say in every decision involving his family. However, things take a turn when he decides to make Daniel a priest.
Keshava Menon and Madhavan Nair are best friends and business partners. When Keshava dies in an accident, his son Balan takes over the company and realises Madhavan's ulterior motives.
Kavitha, a struggling woman, goes through a difficult time while repaying her brother's debts. Later, she takes up an acting job for a commercial and things change drastically.
Unni, who has a feminine voice, gets insulted by everyone in his neighbourhood. His life takes a turn when he gets married to a rich girl who is speech-impaired.
Josy is an unemployed young man who never acts responsibly. His life changes when his beloved mother dies in a fatal accident and his long-lost father returns home.
Nandagopan, a poor villager, writes a script and wants the famous actor Sooryakiran to help him with the film. Sooryakiran rejects him, but he is moved when he takes a deeper look at the script.
Ravishankar, a street urchin, is looked after by Salim, a local don. After Salim's demise, Ravishankar rises to power and fights against an evil gangster.
Jayaraman, a liftman and caretaker, relies on his non-visual senses and martial arts expertise to protect a little girl from a vengeful ex-con who is out to settle an old score.
Prince, a dog trainer, faces an awkward situation when his pet dog Diana acts in a film alongside his former lover, an actress who shares the same name as the dog.
In order to escape Irumba John, a criminal who wants to marry her, Laura moves to a new city. However, she is in trouble when Irumba hunts her down.

Arddhanaari, a man under the guise of a transgender individual, enters a city and begins to kill people, especially the government employees. Eventually, when he is caught, he shares a menacing story.
Mahadevan, a policeman, goes to a village to find the criminals behind a bomb blast. He is determined to unravel the mystery behind the tragedy and gets help from a crazy bunch of local policemen.
Njan Kodiswaran

Meera arrives at brothers Chathukutty Bhagavathar and Chandappan Gurukkal's house claiming to be the Bhagavathar's daughter. However, another man reaches the village and insists that he is her father.
Following the loss of his sister, a young man is forced to reflect on his childhood and reassess his future. However, he finds support and courage from unexpected quarters.
Raji calls Latha and demands INR 5 lacs as a payoff for not revealing her father's secrets. A scared Latha employs the services of Hariharan, whose investigation throws up some startling revelations.
When Karkotakudu, a monster, attempts to destroy Earth to take control of the planet, Rajeshwari, a devotee of Goddess Akkamma, decides to fight the behemoth.
An honest police officer tries to stop a serial killer who has murdered three people already and intends to claim one more life.
